title: Real regularity of complex Hessian obstacle envelopes
established: The complex $m$-Hessian obstacle envelope is locally $C^{1,1}$ in all real coordinates for every $1\le m\le n$, under the stated strict defining-function assumption. The penalized Bellman estimates are uniform in both approximation parameters.
scope_or_remaining: The conclusion concerns exactly the catalogue target; no historical priority claim is made.
author: Matthew J. Colbrook
outcome: Real local C1,1 regularity for every stated complex Hessian obstacle envelope.
